messages:
Nina (PM): Quick sync 10m: we need to lock MVP scope by EOD. Two big asks from customers (tenant SSO + model pinning) but both add infra surface. Proposing: move model pinning to v1, SSO handled via pilot flags. Thoughts?
Hector (Eng): Agree on risk. Model pinning touches rollout/runtime routing and adds stateful orchestration. Likely 2-3 sprint delay if in MVP.
Priya (ML): Model pinning is useful for enterprise evals but not required for public MVP. We can offer pinned weights to pilots as a manual SE action.
Leo (Customer): For our pilot, SSO is an absolute requirement. Model pinning would be nice but not blocking. Pilot OK with a flagged rollout.
Sam (Design): If SSO is pilot-only initially, UX needs to clearly show "pilot feature" and prevent public users from starting flows that will error. I'll draft a small banner + modal.
Nina (PM): Proposed decision: public MVP ships WITHOUT model pinning and WITHOUT public SSO. Enable tenant SSO only for Dedicated/private and invited pilots via tenant feature flag. Add a short-term manual flow for model pin requests (SE-run).
Hector (Eng): Action items: 1) Feature flag gating for SSO on tenant API (PR by Wed), 2) document rollback and canary plan for pilot onboarding, 3) remove model-pinning codepath from public branch and keep in feature branch.
Priya (ML): I'll prepare a test harness to validate pinned-model inference parity for pilots once we enable pinning. Post results in this thread.
Sam (Design): I'll drop banner mock + modal copy by EOD tomorrow. Use copy: "Enterprise sign-in (pilot) available on request".
Leo (Customer): Thanks. We'll confirm pilot timeline once flag is ready. Please also share any temporary support steps.
oncall-bot: Canary policy: public-mvp rollout blocked until canary p95 < 300ms in primary regions.
Nina (PM): I'll update the public MVP one-pager and roadmap snapshot to reflect cuts, and notify growth docs. Reconvene Fri 9am for final sign-off if canary metrics look good.
Hector (Eng): Posting PR links and rollout checklist here when ready.
Priya (ML): Noted 1: if we see model drift after pinning, we should block pilot enablement until eval passes.
Nina (PM): Agreed. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
